fallbacks.cat_mix: cat_time_visits not released (D27); category mix and visit-time profiles are the public defaults
fallbacks.cat_profile: cat_time_visits not released (D27); category mix and visit-time profiles are the public defaults
fallbacks.distance_decay_boundary: fit_decay hit its grid bound 3.0: treat as a lower bound
fallbacks.dropped_tables: place_time_users, stop_transitions_r6, trav_users_r8, trav_users_r9 (v2b) and cat_time_visits, cat_transitions, sensor_step (v2d, D27) are no longer released (noise on real data); their parameters use the documented defaults
fallbacks.groups: no co-visit table released; defaults used
fallbacks.pool_size: Zipf fitted on tier place_users_r7; pool size not identifiable at that resolution
fallbacks.sensor:sensor_noise_m: en-route GPS noise not identifiable from the released tables; hand-set default kept (stop displacement itself is drawn from the stop_jitter histogram)
fallbacks.start_time_fine: time of day is released at 3 bins (morning/midday/evening x daytype) only; the 4-bin values are an assumed HOUR_SHAPE-weighted split of each released bin (a fixed public prior, not measured)
fallbacks.users_per_place_hist: res-8 tier: 6 keys above the noise floor, floor at 72 users (> 5.0); only the tail is observed (places.users_per_place_tail)
fallbacks.zipf_s_tier: zipf_s from coarse tier place_users_r7 (cells, not places)
